## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r Prob13}
y <- seq(0, 1, 0.0001)
rainforest <- dbeta(y,25,10)
deforest <- dbeta(y,10,15)
p=0.1
Avg <- rainforest * (1-p) + deforest * (p)

plot(y,rainforest,lwd = 1 ,col = "blue",ylab="Density of pixels")
lines(y,deforest,lwd = 1,col = "red")
lines(y,NDVI,lwd = 1,col = "purple")
  legend("topright",c("rainforest","deforest","Avg"),
                   lwd=2,col=c("blue","red","purple"))
  
posterior <- p * deforest / (Avg)
plot(y,posterior)
abline(0.9,0)
abline(v=0.5)
abline(v=.45)
# We would be 90% sure that the pixel was deforested if we have a 
#NDVI of ~45 or less

```

```{r prob 17}
#Plot the player i's proportion of successful clutches given by Y makes over n total attempts
#Prior is Beta(a,b) with a=1=b for uniform, Likelihood is Binomial(n,theta)
#Posterior would be beta (y+a n-y+b)
ovprop <- c(0.845,0.847,0.880,0.674,0.909, 0.898,0.770,0.801,0.802,0.875)
makes <- c(64,72,55,27,75,24,28,66,40,13)
totalattempts <- c(75,95,63,39,83,26,41,82,54,16)
player <- c("RW","JH","KL","LJ","IT","SC","GA","JW","AD","KD")
priora <- 1
priorb <- 1
theta <- seq(0,1,0.0001)
plot(theta, dbeta(theta, makes + priora, totalattempts- makes + priorb), ylab = "Density",col = 1:10)
legend("topleft", player, lwd =2, col = 1:10)

```

```{r prob 17}
#Table of 95 CredI
lowerBound <- qbeta(0.05/2, makes + priora, totalattempts- makes + priorb )
upperBound <- qbeta(1- 0.05/2, makes + priora, totalattempts- makes + priorb )
table <- data.frame(
  lowerBound <- round(qbeta(0.05/2, makes + priora, totalattempts- makes + priorb ),2),
   upperBound <- round(qbeta(1- 0.05/2, makes + priora, totalattempts- makes + priorb ),2)
)
colnames(table) <- c("Lower 95 Credible Interval", "Upper 95 Credible Interval")
rownames(table) <- player
table
```
```{r prob 17}
prob <- round(pbeta(ovprop, makes + priora, totalattempts- makes + priorb ),2)
cbind(player, prob)
prob
#As JH and GA have high prob it is most likely that their clutch proportion differs from the rest, both less
#as CDF is < 
```
```{r prob 17}
priora <- 0.5
priorb <- 0.5
prob <- round(pbeta(ovprop, makes + priora, totalattempts- makes + priorb ),2)
cbind(player, prob)
prob

priora <- 5
priorb <- 5
prob2 <- round(pbeta(ovprop, makes + priora, totalattempts- makes + priorb ),2)
cbind(player, prob2)
prob2

#Prior seems to have an effect, large values for a,b increase the prob
#JH is consistently ~.99 prob
```

```{r prob 2}
#Use Poisson-gamma model, for estimating rate of events
#lambda rate is continuous and positive
#Count number of runs in a season (0, number of games)
#Count number of runs in series games (0, number of games)
s <- 10000
a <- 0.001
b <- 0.001
season <- rgamma(s,563 + a, 2820 + b)
series <- rgamma(s,10 + a, 27 + b)
mean(season>series)
#mean is 0.047, very low. So Reggie Jackson performs better in series games than the normal season
```
